value.rationale: Hyperplane-section profiles are central objects in the source paper. The finding upgrades fixed-volume and symmetry information to a full analytic Laplace transform, an exact variance correction strictly greater than the cube baseline, a nontrivial all-dimensional Gaussian limit and a large-deviation rate. These are natural geometric-probabilistic invariants for a growing family, not arbitrary parameters or a restatement of the source volume formula.
